crossRefs.note: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?
But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him;
For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is…
Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to…
If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand…
Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered…
There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but…

translations.web: For he who has died has been freed from sin.
translations.bsb: For anyone who has died has been freed from sin.
translations.kjv: For he that is dead is freed from sin.
translations.asv: for he that hath died is justified from sin.
